description: Canonical entity type registry for the Waypoint knowledge graph. Add types here; do not invent parallel product-local types for the same concept.

types.label: Species
types.description: Organism taxon or species complex.

types.label: Habitat
types.description: Ecological setting or plant community.

types.label: Observation
types.description: A recorded noticing of something in place and time.

types.label: Phenology Event
types.description: Seasonal life-cycle occurrence.

types.label: Terrain Feature
types.description: Landform, aspect, substrate, or structural landscape feature.

types.label: Location
types.description: Named place at any scale.

types.label: Trail
types.description: Path or route.

types.label: River
types.description: Hydrologic linear feature or named watercourse.

types.label: Region
types.description: Administrative or ecological region (county, state, watershed, ecoregion).

types.label: Park
types.description: Protected or managed outdoor area.

types.label: Photo
types.description: Photograph or scene still.

types.label: Article
types.description: Editorial or educational article.

types.label: Research Paper
types.description: Formal study, preprint, or published paper.

types.label: Book
types.description: Book-length work.

types.label: Field Guide
types.description: Identification or place-based field guide.

types.label: Government Publication
types.description: Agency report, bulletin, or public dataset documentation.

types.label: Author
types.description: Person who creates or curates knowledge.

types.label: Organization
types.description: Institution, lab, agency, or land trust.

types.label: Topic
types.description: Living hub for a subject across products.

types.label: Collection
types.description: Curated set — user or editorial.

types.label: Weather Event
types.description: Discrete weather occurrence or short pattern.

types.label: Climate Pattern
types.description: Longer climate or oscillation pattern.

types.label: Season
types.description: Named seasonal window relevant to observation or ecology.

types.label: Historical Event
types.description: Past event with lasting relevance to place or knowledge.

types.label: Satellite
types.description: Orbital platform or earth-observation / weather satellite family.

types.label: Radio Signal
types.description: Signal class, band condition, or radio observation.

types.label: Cyber Incident
types.description: Security event for future infrastructure-aware products.

types.label: Infrastructure
types.description: Built system relevant to landscape, sensing, or communications.
